name: click
description: Choose Always ON or @Click Manual. Click binds a software change to one compact plain-language execution contract, waits for approval, then uses structured runners to return revision-bound evidence for the authorized execution.

interface.shortDescription: Bind AI execution to approved intent and return verifiable evidence.
interface.longDescription: Click turns a software change into one plain-language contract you approve once, then keeps Codex inside that boundary until the implementation and agreed checks are complete. Choose Always ON (recommended) to apply it automatically to software changes or Manual with @Click. Staging validates the contract JSON once and emits an opaque contract_id; the later approval passes only that id, never the JSON again. Questions, explanations, simple read-only inspection, and code review remain lightweight. After approval Click implements in one shot. A structured evidence registry assigns each completion condition one cheapest sufficient primary evidence source by id. Local argv checks reserve Hook-inferred units per source against one cumulative contract budget and current exact receipts are reused only when the contract, mutation revision, protected Git tree, check, execution environment, and executable fingerprint still match. Browser evidence remains serial and deduplicates normalized successful or repeatedly failed inputs instead of imposing a normal call-count or elapsed-session cap. Long-running development servers use a Click-owned supervisor and exact stop lifecycle instead of a foreground mutation. Structured inspect, mutate, service, and verify capabilities execute without a shell in isolated child process groups, reject direct process-control executables, reuse valid evidence, and detect verification-time workspace changes. Plan tools remain available with non-blocking advisory guidance and cannot alter contract authority. The Hook still blocks replacement contracts, unauthorized mutations, repeated current-revision inventory, and duplicate verification while necessary in-scope implementation details remain flexible. Click remains an authorization-and-evidence workflow guardrail rather than an operating-system sandbox. The bundled Fix skill provides the same compact repair flow for direct invocation.
defaultPrompt: Use Click to agree on one clear boundary, approve it once, then implement and run only the checks needed to finish.
Set Click to Always ON for software changes while keeping questions and read-only inspection lightweight.
Use Click's read-only review guard to review this code without repeated repository scans.
